_comment: Machine-readable contract for what a report must contain.
This file is the source for report_qc.py's rules about report shape: which
sections, which layer labels, which priority buckets, which citation spellings
are forbidden, which Mermaid characters break a label, and how far a prose
window reaches. The checker reads them rather than hardcoding patterns, so
none of those can exist in the checker alone. ABAP construct syntax (the
ANCHORS table) stays in the checker: it describes the source, not the report,
and it is the list a repair is allowed to substitute. Each rule carries a
`skill_anchor`: a token that must also appear in
SKILL.md. test_contract_drift.py fails when a rule has no anchor in the
skill, or the skill states a constraint no rule covers.
Why this exists: seven separate fixes in this project were a checker
detector disagreeing with the rule it was supposed to enforce. LINENO
matched two spellings so `L23` scored clean; the Mermaid pattern differed
between the checking half and the fixing half; the exemplar's own snippet
guard had a quote-exemption the skill never granted. A second copy of the
rules inside the checker is the cause, so there is now only this one.

sections.label: 程序定位与业务背景
sections.heading_anchor: 一、程序定位与业务背景
sections.skill_anchor: 一、程序定位与业务背景

sections.label: 执行流程全景图（数据视角）
问题清单与改进建议
sections.heading_anchor: 五、问题清单与改进建议

layers.exempt: fence language only -- an abap-fix fence illustrates a proposed fix and needs no layers
layers.skill_anchor: 每个代码块后三层都必须出现
layers.prose_window: from the closing fence to the next fence of any language or the next heading -- not to the next quoted fence, which let labels inside an intervening abap-fix fence, or the label words anywhere later in the document, satisfy a block that had no prose of its own

violation_kinds.A8-cc: no prose at all inside that window
violation_kinds.A8-pt: prose present inside that window, some labels missing

forbidden_in_location_labels.why: the skill requires naming the subprogram, not citing a line

mermaid.why: bare < > # terminate a label or start a comment, so the diagram does not render

advisories.why: a report can satisfy every rule above and still be a list rather than an analysis
a fabricated block keeps six sections, three layers and four buckets; nothing structural sees it

fence language is the only admission test, but a proposed fix left in an abap fence is probed against the source and reads as fabricated; the exemption used to be positional and skipped the next sub-step's real quote as well -- 12 of 138 quoted statements uninspected on one report

abap and abap-fix locked in only one direction: a fix left in an abap fence is probed and reads as fabricated, but source pasted into an abap-fix fence is never compared with the source at all, so the language tag could be used to opt a quote out of the check that exists to catch invented quotes

_comment: Where the checker runs is itself a measured rule, not a style preference.
Run inside generation, the gate costs 22 points of defect recall: -0.250 at
twenty defects with an exact sign test p=0.0215, and -0.224 at thirty-eight,
the same sign at two resolutions. Run as a separate pass after the analysis
is final, recall returns to a level indistinguishable from no checker at all
(0.035 apart) while transcription accuracy is still gained -- one run found
and corrected eight of its own transcription errors.
What the loop checks makes no difference. An arm that checked only
quotations and an arm that checked everything scored identically, p=1.0. The
cost is the loop occupying writing budget, which section 3 needs. So the
rule is not 'check less' -- it is 'check at a different moment', and a repair
pass may not touch the analysis.
Passing a deterministic check licenses only the claim that the shape is
right. It says nothing about whether the analysis is correct, and nothing
about whether anything was missed. archify states this as a rule --
passing one claim never implies the others -- so it is written down here
rather than left to the reader to infer from the tool names.
claim_separation.deterministic_checks_establish: the report has the required shape and quotes source faithfully
claim_separation.requires_a_named_reviewer_for: whether the analysis is correct and what it missed
claim_separation.reviewer_mechanism: scripts/evaluate.py against a frozen defect list in evals/
